answer.explanation: OrderController in the presentation layer imports and is constructor-injected with OrderReadRepository from the persistence layer. It calls findSummaries directly in list(), so it skips the business layer. FF-S03 flags this because the layering runs presentation -> business -> persistence, and presentation should not reach persistence directly. The README only says the service has three layers. It states no rule about skipping them and grants no exception. The dependency is a read-only query, and routing it through a business-layer service would remove it.
